mode: legacy replay/audit view of a schema-1 run (declared inventory supplied afterwards)

verifier.trust_source: pinned RISC Zero verifier CLI (zkverify) re-run by the oracle per unique (receipt, declared image id); a shared component, not an independent proof-system implementation

arithmetic: sums, commitments and journal decoding recomputed by the oracle's own routines (internal/zk/oracle_arith.go); production helpers and Evaluate are not called
limitations: schema-1 rows and events carry no evaluation id: markers are joined by the declared ordinal order per (request, policy)
schema-1 rows carry no ledger id: ledger grouping is taken from the declared legacy inventory
schema-1 approval events carry no evaluation id: an insert is attributed to the marker it immediately follows
schema-1 producers emitted no decision marker for verification failures: those evaluations are bound to their retained receipt bytes only
schema-1 runs have no ledgers.json: final ledger state is reconstructed from events only
note: Offline business-decision oracle v2 (completeness against the declared inventory, receipt bytes re-verified with the pinned verifier, ledgers reconstructed from ordered events, duplicate suppression derived from ledger history). Trusted: the declared inventory, the fixture authority history, the openings, the verifier binary.
